units.source_text: “还有，狐仙说的话真是活灵活现啊。

en.t: And besides, what the fox spirit said sounded so vivid and lifelike.

units.source_text: 说近来他会有所节制，不那么狂乱吃喝了……

en.t: It said that lately he would show some restraint and would not eat and drink so wildly anymore...

units.source_text: 少爷，你也觉得吧，今天他挺老实的。”

en.t: Young master, you think so too, don't you? He was quite well behaved today.
